visualReview.notes: Inspected seven final portable views against the two individual Qualla west-front and northeast photographs. Verified the four square towers, open west colonnade, contrasting east entrance, two courtyard voids and ribbed transparent dome. Corrected occluded east windows, side wall offsets, missing corner arches, east attic shape and west stair approach.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected seven final shared-material views and the full northeast back view. Sandstone, ashlar, copper and painted metal remain bound at metric scale. Transparent dome uses a distinct local alpha material; ordinary windows remain opaque. The north-up placement overlay follows the mapped outline and tower controls. Flat shared ground is a material fixture, not the independently reviewed terrain.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected nineteen final frames across light, quality, front/back and four forced levels. The dome and four towers remain legible at distance; medium-range opacity increases to preserve the glass shell silhouette. Closeup retains the finer ribs, ramps, window surrounds and simplified relief. Synthetic neighbors are style fixtures. No physical-device frame-rate measurement is claimed.

fidelityReview.scope: Present Reichstag exterior, glass dome and visible dome internals; parliamentary rooms and surrounding landscape excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Original medium-fi present Reichstag exterior from the inspected 2014 west and 2017 northeast local photographs plus Bundestag dome dimensions. Diameter 40 m, rise 23.5 m above approximately 24 m terrace; 24 ribs and 17 divisions at close range. Sculpture, inscriptions, roof and courtyard details and visible dome internals are simplified. Official top-opening dimensions conflict between 8 m and 10 m; model uses approximately 10 m. No parliamentary interior or reference pixels are embedded.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current levels were visually inspected and pass geometry/draw budgets. Skyline keeps dome, towers and entrance silhouette; district restores facades and roof masses; street adds arches, column and dome framing; closeup adds capitals, relief, glazing subdivisions and finer ramps. Error values are authoring budgets, not measured mesh-to-mesh deviations.

geometryValidation.notes: Exact source regeneration, ordinary import verification, four current LOD checks and strict medium-fi audit passed. Source bundle, scene and terrain schemas pass; terrain PNG round-trip error is recorded above. No independent Khronos-validator run is claimed.

limitations: Original medium-fi present exterior, using individually inspected 2014 west-front and 2017 northeast Qualla photographs; not a survey or photogrammetric reconstruction.
Mapped outline, courtyard voids and tower positions are generalized. Roof terrace, courtyard facades, side details and ornament are conservative interpretations.

Dome diameter 40 m and rise 23.5 m follow Bundestag figures; base is approximately 24 m above forecourt. Rounded published total heights differ slightly. Top opening modeled approximately 10 m; another official page says 8 m.

The dome has 24 ribs and 17 horizontal divisions at close range, with four bottom glazing rows omitted. Internal ramps and reflector cone are simplified exterior-visible cues; parliamentary rooms are excluded.
Fine sculpture and inscriptions are simplified original relief forms. No reference image pixels, adjacent buildings, landscaping or temporary security installations are embedded.
Independent terrain is preserved. Other host terrain datasets may differ from the reviewed Berlin DGM1 sample.
